newsitem.title: USA: Shareholder proposes increasing Lund board.
newsitem.headline: Shareholder proposes increasing Lund board.

text.p: Old World Industries Inc said Monday it had proposed to Lund International Holdings Inc that Lund increase the size of its board of directors.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Old World said one or more its representatives had indicated an interest in serving on the board.
Old World, of Northbrook, Ill., said it is currently in discussions with Lund concerning joint marketing cooperation for Lund's products.
Old World holds a 13.5 percent stake in Lund, or 593,000 shares, and said it holds the stake for investment purposes.

Old World is engaged principally in the automotive and industrial chemical businesses. Lund, of Anoka, Minn., is a holding company for Lund Industries Inc, a manufacturer of aftermarket vehicle accessories.
